summary: Comprehensive Phase 1 Security & RBAC Audit of the Django backend API. Documents all IDOR and data-leak vulnerabilities found across 6 API files (api.py, vehicle_api.py, transaction_api.py, settings_api.py, auth_api.py, activity_logs_api.py). Identifies 3 critical vulnerabilities, 2 medium-severity issues, and 4 low-severity recommendations. Includes exact file locations, proposed fixes, and a verification plan.
